patterns.note: Full-bleed dark background with large, distinct content sections presented as dark, rounded cards or full-width content blocks.
Prominent use of image grids, often with rounded corners, to showcase visual content and provide context for AI capabilities.
Hierarchical typography with very large, bold, white sans-serif headings on a dark background, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text.
A high-contrast dark mode palette, primarily black and white, allowing vibrant imagery and subtle accent colors to stand out.
Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scrolling experience.
The initial hero section transforms on scroll, with the overlaid text and image grid receding to reveal the next content block.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky navigation bar that remains at the top of the viewport, maintaining site navigation throughout the scroll.

Design content sections as large, dark, rounded-corner cards or full-width blocks that animate into view using a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they become visible during scrolling, likely leveraging a scroll animation library like Locomotive Scroll.
Create a dynamic hero section where an initial image grid and overlaid text recede or fade out as the user scrolls, smoothly transitioning to the next content block.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing for display, paired with clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded, consistently applied to image containers, buttons, and content cards, giving a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and within large content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness and clear content separation.

standout: The immersive, app-like dark mode experience, where content sections are presented as large, interactive-looking 'cards' that dynamically reveal on scroll, creating a sense of depth and engagement beyond a typical marketing site. The integration of UI elements directly into the marketing content (e.g., the chat UI in the 'Unlock your best creative work' section) is also distinctive.
